title: Custom select
notes: `select, ::picker(select) { appearance: base-select }` turns a plain `<select>` into a fully styleable control: real `<option>` markup with icons and descriptions, a `::checkmark`, and a picker positioned by anchor positioning. No script needed.

`<selectedcontent>` clones the selected option's markup into the closed button, so the status dot updates itself; a CSS rule hides the description in that clone. Chrome and Safari support it; Firefox falls back to a plain, fully usable select.
